page.overview:
Who is H.J. Hollis?

H.J. Hollis is one of the next-gen racers who replaces Parker Brakeston. He races for the team "N2O Cola" in the movie Cars 3.

H.J. Hollis is one of the first next-generation race cars to debut in the Piston Cup. He joined the competition mid-season and entered the N2O Cola racing team, replacing Parker Brakeston. He is one of the six next-generation rookie racers who debut at the Motor Speedway of the South. He finishes 4th at the Grandol Oil Co. Raceway, 6th in the Mood Springs Sputter Stop 350 at the Georgia Super Speedway, 8th in the Bumper Save Gears and Glory 450 at the Heartland Motor Speedway. He later appears in the Los Angeles 500 at the Los Angeles International Speedway. He finishes in seventh place.

The next year, he later competes in the 2017 season where he appears in the Florida 500 at the Florida International Super Speedway. He starts in 3rd position and finishes the race in 4th position.
